judged_text: Race conditions in pagination and add/remove reloads: optimistic offset updates with no request sequencing or cancellation can show stale/overlapping pages

record.issue_text: Race conditions in pagination and add/remove reloads: optimistic offset updates with no request sequencing or cancellation can show stale/overlapping pages

adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces paginated member loading via `Group#findMembers`, which unconditionally `setProperties({ user_count, limit, offset, members })` from the AJAX response. In the controller, `next`/`previous` optimistically update `group.offset` and immediately call `group.findMembers()` with no request sequencing/cancellation. If a user triggers multiple `findMembers()` calls quickly (paging, or add/remove which also calls `findMembers()` in `.then()`), responses can arrive out of order and a slower earlier response will overwrite `members`/`offset` with stale data (since `findMembers` applies response meta regardless of current state). This can show the wrong page/members list.
